title: Complete artifact metadata reads v1
description: Complete current or historical Gateway success envelopes. Metadata only; no object bytes, storage address or upload receipt.
$comment: Source-only contract for parseArtifactReadQuery/parseArtifactReadEnvelope. Register this resource and artifact-comparison.json under their complete IDs before resolving anchors. The comparison resource supplies metadata and historical-envelope definitions, not its local comparison-result root. Runtime remains authoritative for scope/query/trace/version/ETag equality, valid calendar timestamps, UTF-16 limits and ordinary JSON. Client byte budgets are not enforced by this schema or the Gateway detail parser. No authorization or content verification is established.

ArtifactReadQuery.description: Decoded SDK/shared query objects. The HTTP API puts these values in path segments, never URL query fields.

ArtifactCurrentReadEnvelope.$comment: Runtime requires revision=data.artifact.version and outer etag=data.artifact.etag=the version-derived weak tag. The HTTP ETag matches the outer tag. The single outer artifact source binds to the requested ID. Outer trace is this read; metadata trace is the saved version's original trace.

ArtifactHistoricalReadEnvelope.$comment: Complete closed historical envelope; outer etag is forbidden, including null. Metadata etag remains descriptive. Runtime binds revision and metadata.version to the explicit requested version, and requires historical/not-checked.
